beats.narration_text: Jambo, Liam. Today: claude-refactor. Fifty-nine books. Six thousand three hundred and ninety-three reels — none of them in the Claude brand. One command writes the retrofit plan. New open, new outro, new handoff, zero inner beats re-rendered. Liam, in for Bear.

beats.narration_text: Claude-refactor has two parts. A generator that scans a book's youtube directory, drafts the cold-open question for each reel, and writes one REFACTOR.MD with the full retrofit plan. And an executor that Claude Code reads — replacing only the open, outro, handoff, and ASK→RESULT micro-beats, while keeping every inner beat and its media untouched.

props.title: A skill is a folder.
props.calloutText: One artifact: REFACTOR.MD. One rule: inner media is never re-rendered.
props.sparkLine: Generator writes the plan. Executor adds only what's new.

beats.narration_text: The pipeline: resolve the book's topic and target playlist. Inventory the youtube directory — exclude lectures and brand variants. Draft the cold-open question for each reel. Write REFACTOR.MD. Then per video: replace open, outro, handoff; insert ASK→RESULT micro-beats before each generated visual; keep all inner media. Generate audio only for new beats. Render new beats only. Report and stop.

beats.narration_text: Free demo: scan the actual books directory. Fifty-nine books with youtube reels. Six thousand three hundred and ninety-three beat sheets — not counting lecture folders or brand variants. Every one of them eligible to get a Claude cold open and a handoff beat. The scanner reads file paths, writes nothing, spends nothing.

beats.narration_text: Law one: reuse before regenerate. The refactor adds only new beats — cold open, ASK→RESULT micro-beats, handoff, outro. As the SKILL says: an existing inner beat's media is never re-rendered unless the human asks. Your Higgsfield clips, your Manim animations, your narration audio — all kept exactly as they are.

props.heading: Reuse before regenerate.
props.body: Cold open, ASK→RESULT micro-beats, handoff, outro — these are new. Every inner beat and its media stays untouched. Your paid footage is never at risk.
props.quote: an existing inner beat's media is never re-rendered unless the human asks
props.sparkLine: New beats wrap the old ones. Inner footage is sacred.

beats.narration_text: Law two: ASK→RESULT applied retroactively. Every existing generated visual gets a composer micro-beat inserted immediately before it — a realistic prompt that could have produced that exact scene. The SKILL says: insert a composer micro-beat showing a realistic Claude prompt that could generate that scene. The result beat that follows is the existing media, untouched.

props.heading: ASK→RESULT, retroactive.
props.body: A composer micro-beat inserted before each generated visual — a realistic prompt that could produce that scene. The visual that follows is the original footage, untouched.
props.quote: insert a composer micro-beat showing a realistic Claude prompt that could generate that scene
props.sparkLine: Make the prompt visible. Keep the footage intact.

beats.narration_text: Law three: GATE P per reel, per-video human approval before post. PEDAGOGY.md gets a refactor addendum and VERDICT: PASS before any audio spend. Posting requires explicit per-video human approval — never auto-post. As the SKILL says: never posts without per-video human approval. The playlist family is Claude for topic — never post refactored cuts to the Brutalist playlists.

props.heading: Gate P + per-video approval.
props.body: PEDAGOGY.md refactor addendum required before audio spend. Posting requires explicit per-video approval. Refactored cuts route to 'Claude for <topic>' — never the Brutalist playlists.
props.quote: Never posts without per-video human approval.
props.sparkLine: Audit before spend. Approve before post. Every time.

beats.narration_text: Verdict: claude-refactor retrofits any book's videos to the Claude brand in one command — cold open, ASK→RESULT micro-beats, handoff, outro. Inner media is never re-rendered. Gate P audits every reel before audio spend. Human approves every post.
